help.text: Devices are set up on the setup page (instance link, globe icon). There you also find the QR code for Apple Home.

bridgeName.label: Name of the bridge in Apple Home

hapPort.label: HomeKit port
hapPort.help: Must be free; change only if another HomeKit bridge (e.g. Homebridge, yahka) uses it

publicHost.label: Address of the ioBroker server for the link (optional)

accessKey.label: Access key for the setup page (optional)
accessKey.help: The page shows the HomeKit code - protect it if others use your network
